title: Turntide Islands
audience: Curious adults interested in the ideas and public life of the existing Turntide Islands community.
promise: Cinematic, source-grounded explanations supporting Turntide Islands’ existing community: responding to climate weirding and compound crises through knowledge, care and shared practice.

lessons.title: Responding, rather than reacting, to climate weirding
lessons.question: How can people move from reacting to compound climate crises toward shared, place-specific adaptation practices, and what role does a community like Turntide Islands play?
lessons.whyItMayMatter: Begin with Turntide Islands’ actual public mission: care, curiosity, respect, useful knowledge and practices under climate weirding and compound crises.

lessons.title: How a community makes knowledge it can return to
lessons.question: How can a developed community preserve a useful claim with its source and context, and use it again in conversation without treating every discussion as a document-production task?
lessons.whyItMayMatter: How can a developed community preserve a useful claim with its source and context, and use it again in conversation without treating every discussion as a document-production task?

lessons.title: From a news story to a useful question
lessons.question: How can a public news item become a concrete question about everyday life, with theory helping explain a mechanism rather than replacing the evidence?
lessons.whyItMayMatter: How can a public news item become a concrete question about everyday life, with theory helping explain a mechanism rather than replacing the evidence?

lessons.title: Care that survives the paperwork
lessons.question: What distinguishes reciprocal care from administrative risk management, and how can a community preserve that distinction in its ordinary relationships?
lessons.whyItMayMatter: What distinguishes reciprocal care from administrative risk management, and how can a community preserve that distinction in its ordinary relationships?

lessons.title: A living community remembers differently
lessons.question: How can a community keep useful memory without flattening its people, meanings and disagreements into a generic software template?
lessons.whyItMayMatter: How can a community keep useful memory without flattening its people, meanings and disagreements into a generic software template?
